description_en: Queries the latest available custom image in a specified image family
description_zh: 查询指定镜像族系内最新创建的可用自定义镜像
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-image-from-family --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-family hangzhou-daily-update --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeImageFromFamily

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the image. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 镜像所在的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the image. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list

parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The name of the image family.

Image families are supported for custom images, public images, community images, and shared images. For more information, see [Image family overview](~~174241~~).
